title: notification.whatsapp.setup_requested
description: Internal to notification. An organization completed WhatsApp Embedded Signup and a setup run (token, number, webhook, templates, verify) is waiting to be executed. Staged in the same transaction as the run and consumed by `notification.consumers.run_whatsapp_setup`. Carries ids only: the authorization code and the token are sealed on the run row and never travel on an event.
